name: (Secret Society) Skill Savvy
text: The secret society member has a few tricks most others do not. They gain two of the following skill feats: Charming Liar, Courtly Graces, Glean Contents, Hobnobber, Lengthy Diversion, Lie to Me, Quick Coercion, or Streetwise. If they are at least 2nd level, they can also choose from among the following: Discreet Inquiry, Glad-Hand, or Lasting Coercion. If they are at least 7th level, they can also choose Shameless Request or Slippery Secrets.
